Key Features: Fully Automatic: Enjoy instant access to your favorite shows with the touch of a button. No manual adjustments required – it’s as simple as press and play. Dual Output Capability: Comes with two coaxial outputs, providing the flexibility to support two receivers or a dual-tuner DVR, so everyone in the RV can watch what they like. In-Motion Viewing: There’s no need to pull over for programming. Watch live television without interruptions, even on highways and byways. Quiet Operation: The updated design of the T4 not only provides improved tracking of satellites but does so with significantly reduced noise. Compact Size: Winegard's smallest in-motion antenna takes up minimal roof space and eliminates the need for storage space. Multi-Provider Compatibility: Whether you prefer DISH, DIRECTV, or Bell TV, the T4 is capable of receiving signals from any of these services. Improved Tracking: Engineered to track satellites more efficiently, the Roadtrip T4 ensures you stay tuned in to your shows with less risk of losing signal.
